channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: Trump names Adam Telle acting Army secretary after Driscoll resigns
item.description: Adam Telle's elevation to acting Army secretary raises durable questions about civilian control, institutional continuity, and the cost of leadership churn in wartime.

item.title: Trump warns Britain of disaster; Vance declines to call Iran conflict a war
item.description: Trump told GB News Britain is 'on the edge of disaster' as Vance declined to call U.S.-Iran exchanges a war at the first White House briefing in 40 days.

item.title: Miami fintech Félix raises $200M to expand beyond remittances
item.description: The Miami startup hits a $1.4 billion valuation and plans to move from money transfers into lending, savings, and AI financial coaching.

item.title: Inter Miami hosts Atlanta United in adidas night at Nu Stadium
item.description: Inter Miami host struggling Atlanta United on Saturday in an adidas-branded night that ends with a Special Olympics match at Nu Stadium.

item.title: Lawmakers and advocates press Capitol Hill to extend El Salvador TPS
item.description: With El Salvador's TPS set to expire September 9, lawmakers, faith leaders, and advocates are pressing DHS for an extension as the administration signals skepticism.

item.title: Noah Allen transfers to Chicago Fire, clearing Messi's path to appearance record
item.description: Inter Miami loans defender Noah Allen to Chicago Fire for $3 million, leaving Lionel Messi chasing an appearance record he cannot break until 2027.

item.title: House rejects constitutional amendment to fix Supreme Court at nine justices
item.description: The House voted 212-206 on September 3 to reject H.J.Res. 1, falling well short of the two-thirds majority a constitutional amendment requires.

item.title: LA Escena festival brings free Hispanic classical theater to UCLA
item.description: LA Escena returns to UCLA this fall with free performances, international artists, and a rare look at Spanish Golden Age theater.

item.title: New York Latino Film Festival returns for 26th edition in September
item.description: The 26th NYLFF runs September 13–20, 2026, spotlighting more than 125 films from nearly 20 countries during Hispanic Heritage Month.

item.title: Missouri Supreme Court blocks new US House map, orders voter referendum
item.description: Missouri's redistricting clash layers a century-old tension between direct democracy and federal elections law into a single, urgent deadline.

item.title: USMCA review stalls as nearshoring and tariff disputes loom
item.description: The USMCA missed its July 2026 renewal deadline, rattling farmers, manufacturers, and nearshoring investors across North America.

item.title: Inter Miami loans homegrown defender Noah Allen to Chicago Fire
item.description: The 22-year-old Pembroke Pines native heads to Chicago on loan through 2026, with a $3 million permanent trade option attached.

item.title: Leon Black sues House Oversight Committee, defies Epstein probe subpoena
item.description: Leon Black filed suit in federal court to block two House Oversight subpoenas hours before skipping a scheduled deposition in the Epstein probe.

item.title: Messi wins MLS Goal of the Matchday after four-goal Inter Miami rout
item.description: Messi netted four goals and an assist as Inter Miami crushed CF Montréal 7-1, the club's highest-scoring match ever.

item.title: Vance refuses to call Iran conflict a war or set end date
item.description: Vice President Vance declined to call the six-month-old Iran conflict a war or offer an end date at a White House briefing Thursday.

item.title: Mexico's informal economy grows 2% in Q1 2026, outpacing overall GDP
item.description: Mexico's shadow economy expanded five times faster than overall GDP in Q1 2026, with 32.6 million workers now outside formal labor protections.

item.title: Mexico women's U-20 side opens World Cup campaign in Poland
item.description: Mexico opens against Benin on September 5 at Arena Katowice, kicking off a 24-team tournament that runs through September 27 in Poland.

item.title: Timerman says investors trust Argentina's economic policy will hold
item.description: Adcap's Javier Timerman says Wall Street backs Argentina's fiscal path but watches the 2027 election as the program's biggest threat.

item.title: GAO report finds Secret Service let protection policies lapse for years
item.description: A GAO report released September 3 found the Secret Service failed to update eight of 22 protection policies within the required four-year window.

item.title: Maryland Supreme Court allows redistricting question on November ballot
item.description: The Maryland Supreme Court ruled Question 3 may appear on the November 3 ballot after two circuit courts had blocked the redistricting measure.

item.title: Trump moves to brand federal buildings, strip school tax status, and fortify White House
item.description: The Trump administration unveiled plans for a Potomac arch, a tax rule targeting private schools, and permanent fencing around Lafayette Square on September 3.

item.title: Kany García brings Puerta Abierta tour to the US
item.description: The Puerto Rican singer-songwriter brings her biggest tour yet stateside, opening September 7 in California and hitting 16 US cities through October.

item.title: Mourinho says he'll watch MLS after Messi's Argentina retirement
item.description: José Mourinho says fans must tune into MLS to catch Messi's final years after the Argentine great retired from international football.

item.title: Organizations across the US launch Hispanic Heritage Month 2026 programs
item.description: From Florida classrooms to Colorado fiestas, communities nationwide are marking Hispanic Heritage Month 2026 with scholarships, exhibitions, and cultural celebrations.

item.title: House passes bill to cut funds to colleges that boycott Israel
item.description: A bipartisan House vote to defund college boycotts of Israel raises durable questions about where campus autonomy, federal money, and free expression intersect.

item.title: AFA orders 10th-minute applause tribute to Messi at all matches
item.description: The AFA mandates a 10th-minute pause across all divisions to honor Lionel Messi, 39, after his retirement from international football.

item.title: Brazil and ECB study linking Pix to European payments platform
item.description: The ECB confirmed a preliminary study into linking its TIPS platform with Brazil's Pix, with a pilot possible by 2028.

item.title: Judge blocks Trump's August birthright citizenship executive order
item.description: A federal judge in Maryland on September 2 blocked President Trump's August executive order restricting birthright citizenship, calling it almost certainly unconstitutional.

item.title: Brazil and Paraguay to face Japan and Singapore in November tournament
item.description: A four-nation football tournament hits Singapore's National Stadium in November 2026, featuring Brazil, Japan, Paraguay, and the host nation.

item.title: Carney rejects Lutnick's account of collapsed trade talks
item.description: Carney says Canada will return to the table when Washington is ready, denying Lutnick's claim that Ottawa torpedoed talks for electoral gain.

item.title: Twin Minds Media adds five divisions to serve Hispanic market
item.description: The Miami agency splits into five named divisions covering PR, influencers, social, production, and events after a decade in the Hispanic market.

item.title: DOJ charges ICE officer Castro with false statements in Minnesota shooting
item.description: Federal prosecutors charged ICE officer Christian Castro with false statements over a January shooting in Minneapolis that occurred during the Trump administration's immigration enforcement surge.

item.title: Brazil's Senate approves critical minerals regulation bill
item.description: Brazil's Senate passed legislation Wednesday creating a legal framework for rare earths and other critical minerals, sending the bill to President Lula for his signature.

item.title: Judge hears arguments on extending USPS mail-ballot ban
item.description: A federal judge in Boston weighed whether to extend a block on a USPS rule implementing President Trump's mail-voting executive order.

item.title: Bipartisan House INSULIN Act introduced with two vulnerable Republicans
item.description: Five House lawmakers from both parties introduced legislation September 3 to cap out-of-pocket insulin costs at $35 per month for privately insured patients.

item.title: Woodside and PEMEX sign MOU for deepwater Gulf of Mexico exploration
item.description: Woodside and PEMEX sign a non-binding MOU to explore deepwater Gulf of Mexico opportunities, building on their $7.2 billion Trion project.

item.title: The Warning to headline Mexico City's Estadio GNP Seguros in 2027
item.description: The Monterrey rock sisters are making history on multiple fronts, from Billboard charts to the biggest stadium stage in Mexico City.

item.title: Gloria Steinem, feminist activist and Ms. Magazine co-founder, dies at 92
item.description: Gloria Steinem's death at 92 closes a chapter in American civic life that reshaped how millions understood gender, power, and public voice.

item.title: Pemex launches international tender for high-spec jackup rig
item.description: Pemex wants a high-spec jackup capable of drilling to 30,000 ft, with bids opening in late September and a contract award set for October 7.

item.title: Musk's America PAC spends $800K on 2026 midterm races
item.description: Elon Musk's America PAC reported more than $800,000 in independent expenditures supporting Republican candidates across more than a dozen states.
